title: App message
description: One UTF-8 JSON message inside a Noise transport frame, SPEC.md §4.4. Receivers ignore unknown fields and ignore messages with an unknown t (or evt with an unknown e); a req with an unknown op is answered with ok:false, code unsupported.

op.description: inbox.get, a chat.* op (SPEC.md §6.3), or a §7.4/§8 op such as task.new or stream.new

params.description: Op-specific (SPEC.md §6.3, §8); the chat ops take an object with tabId, stream.new #/$defs/streamNewParams, project.new #/$defs/projectNewParams, branches.list #/$defs/branchesListParams, task.land #/$defs/taskLandParams, queue.update #/$defs/queueUpdateParams, queue.run #/$defs/queueRunParams, stream.run #/$defs/streamRunParams, stream.logs #/$defs/streamLogsParams, stream.commands.get and stream.commands.suggest #/$defs/streamCommandsParams, stream.commands.set #/$defs/streamCommandsSetParams, tokens.usage #/$defs/tokensUsageParams.

result.description: Op-specific; an Inbox for inbox.get, chat.schema.json for the chat ops, #/$defs/streamNewResult and #/$defs/branchesListResult for stream.new and branches.list, #/$defs/projectNewResult for project.new, #/$defs/taskCloseResult and #/$defs/taskLandResult for task.close and task.land, #/$defs/queueUpdateResult and #/$defs/queueRunResult for queue.update and queue.run, #/$defs/streamRunResult and #/$defs/streamLogsResult for stream.run and stream.logs, #/$defs/streamCommandsResult, #/$defs/streamCommandsSetResult and #/$defs/streamCommandsSuggestResult for stream.commands.get, .set and .suggest, #/$defs/tokensUsageResult for tokens.usage.

code.description: unsupported, bad-request, not-authorized, internal, not-found, gone, or newer codes

streamNewParams.description: stream.new params (SPEC.md §8.12). branch and baseBranch only count with worktree: true.

commandId.description: Which of the stream's commands (stream.run.commands); absent means its first.

taskId.description: start/restart: run in that task's own worktree (stream.run.task).

streamRunResult.description: stream.run result (SPEC.md §8.19): empty; the run's state arrives in the next inbox.

commandId.description: Which of the stream's commands (stream.run.commands); absent means its first.

streamLogsResult.description: stream.logs result (SPEC.md §8.19): the end of the run's output as plain text, at most 200000 characters; truncated when the start was cut off.

streamCommandsParams.description: stream.commands.get and stream.commands.suggest params (SPEC.md §8.21): no streamId means the project's own commands.

streamCommandsResult.description: stream.commands.get result (SPEC.md §8.21): that list's commands, and with streamId the project's (inherited, absent when none).

streamCommandsSetParams.description: stream.commands.set params (SPEC.md §8.21): the whole list, at most 20, names unique ignoring case (not expressible here).

id.description: Keeps the command of that id in the list; absent: a fresh id.

streamCommandsSetResult.description: stream.commands.set result (SPEC.md §8.21): empty; the merged commands arrive in the next inbox.

streamCommandsSuggestResult.description: stream.commands.suggest result (SPEC.md §8.21): what Claude suggests; nothing is saved.

branchesListResult.description: branches.list result (SPEC.md §8.13): local branches, and the one the desktop's dialog picks first ("" when there is none).

tokensUsageParams.description: tokens.usage params (SPEC.md §8.22): absent projectId means every project the phone sees.

tokensUsageResult.description: tokens.usage result (SPEC.md §8.22): per project, the tokens by day, agent and model; unavailable when the desktop can't read the project's sessions.

tokensUsageRow.description: One day's tokens of one agent (claude, codex, pi, or a newer one) and model (SPEC.md §8.22). input is fresh input, not read from the cache.

queueUpdateParams.description: queue.update params (SPEC.md §8.16). add takes text and streamId?, edit itemId and text, remove itemId, move itemId and toIndex, auto-run streamId and on.

queueUpdateResult.description: queue.update result (SPEC.md §8.16): the new prompt's itemId for add, {} otherwise.

queueRunResult.description: queue.run result (SPEC.md §8.16): the task the prompt became.

taskCloseResult.description: task.close result (SPEC.md §8.7): archived, a blocker to confirm, (version 3) a task with a worktree of its own that didn't land, or (task.close.choice, with ask) the desktop's close question.

taskLandResult.description: task.land result (SPEC.md §8.15). closed: true when the landing finished a close; landing is the task's landing now.
